title: feat(core): pure row-to-definition mappers for the ADR-0131 upgrade ceremony (C7b build-ahead, PR 1 of 2)
body:
Part of #22937
Clause-②: yes
Part of #15211

PR 1 of 2 of the C7b build-ahead card: E5's pure row → definition mappers, in core (seat answer 6110777865, E5 → A; its note on #15211, 6110790598). PR 2 (`os migrate organization-ownership --apply`) is a separate PR from `main` and is not in this diff. No closing keyword here: PR 2 completes #22937.

## What changes

Two pure functions in `@objectstack/core`, beside `convertPositionBindingRows` in `packages/core/src/security/`, each in a new file with its own pins, exported from `security/index.ts` (and so from the package's `.` entry):

- `permissionSetDefinitionFromRow(row)` (`permission-set-row-definition.ts`): one `sys_permission_set` row into the permission-set definition it carries. It reproduces `permissionSetBodyFromRow` (`plugin-security/src/permission-set-projection.ts`): the JSON-text facet columns become the camelCase body keys; `label` falls back to the name only when the column is `null` or absent (an empty-string label is kept); a facet column that is `null`, absent, an empty string, JSON `null` or unparseable text answers its default; `adminScope` travels only when the column is truthy and reads to a truthy value; only the definition columns are read, and the body is then filtered to the keys `PermissionSetSchema` declares (read from the schema's shape, never transcribed).
- `positionDefinitionFromRow(row)` (`position-row-definition.ts`): one `sys_position` row into `{ name, label, description, delegatable }`. It reproduces the mapping the row-only position backfill (`position-environment-backfill.ts`) applies, which is `positionBodyFromRow` in `plugin-security/src/position-write-through.ts`.
- Row types `PermissionSetRowForDefinition` and `PositionRowForDefinition` (the columns read, plus an index signature: other columns are accepted and ignored). Both functions return a string-keyed record of `unknown` values (TypeScript's `Record` of `string` to `unknown`), the type the plugin's copies return, so 7a/7b can switch to them without a cast.

Helpers copied into core (new files only): `parseMaybeJson` and the spec-key filter (`permissionSpecBodyKeys` / `pickSpecDeclaredKeys`, folded into the function) from `permission-set-projection.ts`; `positionBodyFromRow` is itself the position mapping. Core already depends on `@objectstack/spec` and already imports values from `@objectstack/spec/security`, so no dependency is added. Nothing in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/**` is edited; #15204's 7a/7b switch to these functions and delete their copies.

**No behaviour changes.** Nothing calls the new functions yet, and neither runs at boot.

## Equivalence with the plugin-security originals (one-time measurement)

Core's tests cannot import plugin-security without a new dependency (core is plugin-security's dependency), so the permanent pins assert the documented outputs on hand-written fixtures, and byte-for-behaviour equivalence was measured once with a scratch script (not committed). It imports the originals and the core functions from source with `tsx`, and compares them over a generated population of rows with `util.isDeepStrictEqual` (which tells a missing key from an `undefined` one), plus key order and `JSON.stringify`, plus thrown errors:

- permission sets: 60,244 rows (exhaustive over name × label × description × `admin_scope`; every facet column over 20 values × 20 bases; 50,000 seeded random rows over every column at once, with state columns; `null`, `undefined`, `{}`; the test's own fixture). **0 differing.**
- positions: 20,737 rows (exhaustive over name × label × description × `delegatable`, each with and without the row-state columns; the test's own fixture). **0 differing.**
- Positive control: the same harness against mutated variants (an empty label falling back to the name; `delegatable: 'yes'` reading true) reports 7,174 and 1,152 differing rows, so the comparison can fail.

Run at head `e975c410bc` (and once before, at `e5c8727332`), same counts. The final head `d477e5fbef` is a wording-only commit: changeset text, one docblock line and one test comment, so no code line differs from `e975c410bc`.

## Pins

- `permission-set-row-definition.test.ts` (12 tests): full stored row → exact body in key order; every emitted key is declared on `PermissionSetSchema` and none is filtered away (a spec rename reddens this); a well-formed row's body passes `PermissionSetSchema.safeParse`; no state, provenance or identity column travels; already-parsed facets kept; the defaults for absent, `null`, empty, JSON-null and unparseable facets; fresh defaults per call; the label and description rules; the `adminScope` rule; a `null`/`undefined` row; purity (frozen row, same answer twice).
- `position-row-definition.test.ts` (9 tests): the four keys in order; every key declared on `PositionSchema` and a well-formed body passes its `safeParse`; no row-state column travels; the label, description and `delegatable` rules; two rows of one name serialize equal exactly when their definitions agree (the backfill's agreement check reads that); the name is not judged; purity.

## Ablation (committed state, restored and proven)

Both legs through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 → 0, replacement 0 → 1, blob changed), inside a script with an absolute-path `trap` restore; the subject is imported by relative path, so no `dist/` is involved.

- `permissionSetDefinitionFromRow`: `label: row?.label ?? row?.name,` → `label: row?.label,`. 2 of 12 fail (the label rule; the defaults row, whose expected label is the name). Restored: blob `f4e53ca6a2cb` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `positionDefinitionFromRow`: `row.delegatable === '1'` → `row.delegatable === 'one'`. 1 of 9 fails (the `delegatable` rule). Restored: blob `b998eca94d1a` equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty.

Direction observed: red, as expected.

All 63 were run at `e975c410bc`, each exit code captured before any pipe: **63 x exit 0**. `--ran` reconciliation: 63 derived, 63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (derived from the recorded codes), 0 UNRUN. Readings of note: `check:dts-closure` 72 built packages swept, 171/171 declaration files present; `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` 107 require entry points across 66 packages load (core's two declared-unreachable declaration splits are the existing ledger entries); `check:lean-entry-closure` `@objectstack/objectql/core` admitted set held exactly (15 packages, both conditions); `check:type-check-debt` 26 raw errors, none above record; `check:published-files`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:issue-citations`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes` green.
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core test`** at `e975c410bc`: 96 files, 2,402 tests passed. Both new files are in the `local` project's population (`vitest list --project local` names them).
- **`pnpm --filter @objectstack/core typecheck`** at `e975c410bc`: exit 0. The test layer's ledger holds at 4 files / 4 errors, none in the new files, which `tsconfig.test.json`'s program includes (`--listFiles`).

Population: all 5 sit inside `eslint.config.mjs` (an ignored file reports as a warning; none did). Invariance: the config never enables type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no typed rules), and its four local plugins are per-file AST rules whose only file read is the query-options baseline JSON, which this diff does not touch, so no untouched file's verdict can move. The full `pnpm lint` is CI's.
- **Consumers.** Two functions and two types are added; no existing export changes shape, so no import site is affected.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not moved, by design.** The card scopes a row → definition mapping. The backfill's two decisions around it stay in plugin-security: the metadata door's position-name grammar (`metadataDoorAcceptsPositionName`) and "the rows of one name must agree". Both decide what to write, which PR 2's `--apply` decides per name. The core mapping's determinism, key order included, is pinned so that comparing two rows' serialized definitions stays meaningful. When 7b deletes `position-write-through.ts`, the name predicate goes with it. PR 2 can rely on the door's own refusal (`saveMetaItem` enforces the item-name grammar and `PositionSchema.name`), or move the predicate into core at that point. Carrier: PR 2 of #22937, and the 7b stage of #15204.
- **Re-exported further.** `@objectstack/runtime` (`src/index.ts`) and `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` (`src/adapter.ts`) run `export * from '@objectstack/core'`, so they re-export the two functions too. `git grep` finds the four new names only in core, so nothing collides.
- **S8 overlap.** #15204's S8 branch (`claude/issue-15204-s8-catalog-objects`) deletes `packages/core/src/security/row-active.ts` and removes its export block from `security/index.ts`. This PR adds its block after `convertPositionBindingRows`, a different hunk, and neither new file imports `row-active.ts`.
- **Contract review.** `Clause-②: yes`: two exports widen `@objectstack/core`'s published `.` entry, so the changeset is `minor` and one contract-tier review is owed before the queue.
- **The equivalence harness is not committed.** It is a one-time proof, as ablations are.
